Description
Bullion Trading LLC brings our investors and collectors a product from the most reputable bullion manufacturer with a long-standing history of the finest craftsmanship of over 150 years, the Credit Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar. This .9999 pure credit suisse gold 1 oz gold bar is the ultimate safe-haven asset and the best choice to enhance your portfolio.
This beautiful Swiss 1 oz Credit Suisse Gold Bar has a unique serial number and certificate that attests to its weight and purity. The 1 ounce gold bar credit suisse is shipped in tamper-evident packaging along with the assay card stating the gold bar’s weight, purity, and serial number.
Design of Credit Suisse One Ounce Fine Gold 999.9 Bar
The obverse of the Swiss gold bar has the Credit Suissee logo engraved on the top of the bar. Its face also has the weight, metal content, and purity of the bar engraved. The additional engraving on the bar includes the assay mark and the serial number of the bar.
The Swiss Gold Bar’s reverse features the repeated logo of Credit Suisse at a diagonal angle covering the entire reverse side of the bar.
